title: Report and disable UBB with PowerShell
subtitle: Connect, read UBB status, disable sharing, then write a CSV report.

steps.title: Connect to the admin center
steps.evidence: Connect to your SharePoint admin center with PnP PowerShell

steps.title: Read each site's UBB status
steps.evidence: call the SP.UBB.GetUBB endpoint per site, and export IsUBB, EnabledDate and credit status to CSV.

steps.title: Turn off Copilot Credit sharing
steps.evidence: the source's script posts to SP.UBB.SetUBB(isUBB=false) per site; it only disables sharing

steps.title: Write results to a CSV report
steps.evidence: can turn off Copilot Credit sharing, logging results to a CSV report.
